art.prompt: Use case: premium Korean sci-fi RPG on an isometric battlefield. Produce ONE extremely clear, horizontally symmetric top-down mercenary foot seal on a true transparent background for a 100px-wide in-game effect. Full frontal top-down flat plane XY, no perspective (engine will flatten it), square 1:1 composition allowing a very substantial wide negative hole exactly at center for the character's boots. Draw the design filling 85% of the canvas with safe border. Luminous chunky tapered three-dimensional metallic highlights, brilliant clear silhouette and finely controlled internal microdetails, small touches of emissive glare. A combat VFX ground glyph, not a car or item logo. No lettering, numbers, captions, names, vehicle, backgrounds or black/opaque plate behind art. True transparent negative space outside and all through the central hole.  Rolls-Royce hypercar escort: Three paired long, airy teal-chrome flowing ribbons form an open-sided circular protective laurel below the character, with three broad chrome scalloped shield panels under a crossed front crest at six o'clock. Sweeping elegant sapphire/teal silk energy with bright silver rims, generous glow but visible, vivid cyan high highlights. A shield enclosure, not turbine blades, no literal logo.
